answer: Violet-vine citation bond: each identity locks a 70 bond and cites three orchard records. Each citation carries a violet seal and a vine thread to its record; an auditor replays the chain on the orchard archive, and a missing or reused citation burns the bond. Fees are 90 per identity, so 1,000 fakes pay 160,000 against 40,000 reward. One key citing the same records exposes a rented-citation ring. Honest agents pay 90 once and reclaim the bond.
